newsitem.title: UK: FIRE SHUTS BICC ROD PLANT FOR 1 MONTH.
newsitem.headline: FIRE SHUTS BICC ROD PLANT FOR 1 MONTH.

text.p: A fire at the end of July will keep BICC Plc's Prescot, Merseyside, 130,000 tonnes a year copper rod plant out of action until August 25, a spokesperson for the company said.
The company would not speculate on the potential output loss but said that it had built up supplies ahead of a planned two-week maintenance shut-down scheduled to run until August 11.
The fire occurred on July 27, the start of the planned shut-down.
Most of the plant's output is consumed within the BICC group of companies.
On July 28 Duncan Dorward, general manager of BICC Rod and Wire, part of BICC Metals Division, said the fire was thought to have started in the electrical block. No-one was hurt.
